recap.text: Crawler Donut is assigned a lawyer named Princess Chandra, Esquire, after Quasar wore a tie for the job and lost it. Donut declines every offer during a meeting with Chandra that produces fireworks. Quasar tells Crawler Carl that Chandra is not a catgirl, but Carl's new wife.

Chandra is a Naga lawyer and widow of Rishi. She uses Widow's Rights to marry Carl and places Donut under a conservatorship. Donut calls her a sad little snake. Carl opens a legendary fan box containing Rishi's wrecked furniture and a melted GreaserBall trophy. Chandra vanishes after Donut puts a hit on her. Tempest shoots two Taurins, and Quasar hires Kiki for legal and other help.

beats.headline: A lawyer who is also a wife
beats.text: For the record: Crawler Donut has been assigned a lawyer other than Quasar. Quasar argued for the job, wore a tie for it, and lost it. The name on the assignment is Princess Chandra, Esquire. She and Crawler Donut have already met, Donut has declined every offer, and the word reaching Quasar is that there were serious fireworks in that meeting, and not the good kind. Crawler Carl asks whether she is another catgirl. Quasar says no. Worse. She is Crawler Carl's new wife.
beats.gist: Princess Chandra, Esquire, becomes Crawler Carl's new wife.

beats.headline: Widow's Rights, filed in hours
beats.text: Filing summary. Chandra is Naga, a lawyer, and was the second wife of Rishi, whom Crawler Carl killed. After a coup put her uncle on the throne she accepted the title of princess, which she needed to claim Widow's Rights: the old law that lets a royal widow take her husband's assassin as her new husband. A public jury found the idea funny and approved it. As Carl's wife she has signed contracts, placed Crawler Donut under a conservatorship with Carl as guardian, and, after a discreet payment to a district judge's reelection campaign, been assigned Donut's attorney. Two Taurins are on their way to eliminate Quasar.
beats.gist: Chandra is a Naga attorney and Rishi's widow who marries Carl to claim Widow's Rights.

beats.headline: Donut reads every page
beats.text: The meeting, held in a type-A containment zone. Crawler Donut declines every deal, then reads each filing without a question: the conservatorship, the seized Princess Posse accounts, the lawsuits. She pauses only at the marriage certificate. Then she compares the stack to the papers from Carl's father's trailer and tells Chandra what they both show: a picture of who someone is. What a sad little snake you are, she says. I pity you. Chandra loses her temper. Donut announces to any reporters watching that she is definitely not offering fifty million credits to have her turned inside out.
beats.gist: Donut reads filings in a containment zone and tells Chandra she is a sad little snake.

beats.headline: Questions from the Taurins
beats.text: Directly after the non-offer, a message arrives from Chandra's Taurin associates, the pair paid to eliminate Quasar. They have questions about the job and want her coordinates. Their meetings are always in person. She tells herself it is a coincidence, and it rattles her anyway. She gathers her folders and cannot bring herself to reach through Crawler Donut's image for the last one. Donut offers her lesson one in being a princess: do not get so frightened that you wet yourself. Chandra looks down to check. She has not. Not yet, says Donut.
beats.gist: Chandra receives a message from Taurin associates who want her coordinates to ask about Quasar.

beats.headline: The wedding gift arrives
beats.text: The traditional Naga wedding gift is the holdings of the defeated, and the jury put it in a legendary fan box for the groom. Crawler Donut has been waiting for Carl to learn he is married to that stupid lady with the gross nails. Carl opens it in the safe room: a cobra head, from which Rishi's household pours out. Clothes, wrecked furniture, scorched electronics, a shot-through microwave, and a melted participation trophy from a GreaserBall tournament, the placing removed from the plaque. It keeps coming until the pile nearly reaches the ceiling and the room smells of fire. The cleaner bot takes it personally.
beats.gist: Carl opens a legendary fan box in the safe room and Rishi's household pours out.

beats.headline: Still filing, from hiding
beats.text: Status. Princess Chandra vanished the moment Crawler Donut put the hit on her, and her filings keep arriving regardless. Quasar is due to argue against her over the legality of the marriage certificate and expects to lose, though his filing has paused much of what she started. Her contract with the Taurins still stands. Two of them reach the home of Quasar's brother, hurt him, and take over his niece Tempest's call to name terms. Tempest shoots both with the blaster her uncle gave her. Quasar sends Kiki a single credit, and hires her for legal help and the other kind.
beats.gist: Princess Chandra vanishes after Crawler Donut puts a hit on her, but her filings keep arriving.
